name: SkyTaxi
detailed_description:
SkyTaxi is a high-energy 2.5D flying taxi game set in a futuristic, cyberpunk world. Players navigate 2D movement within a fully 3D environment, transporting passengers, meeting daily objectives for their boss, and overcoming increasingly complex challenges as they progress.

Core Gameplay

Players take control of a futuristic taxi, navigating a maze of flying bases, dodging obstacles, and keeping an eye on the fuel gauge while racing against the clock. Using impulse-based flight controls, players must skillfully balance gravity to land smoothly and avoid crashes. The core gameplay challenges players to prioritize picking up passengers while managing fuel for maximum efficiency. Additionally, each level features a special box that can be carried and released by the taxi, helping players by destroying drones, stunning robots, and blocking street cleaners, making it easier to pick up passengers from their bases.

Visuals and Style

The game features a visually immersive cyberpunk aesthetic in 2D space, with all elements rendered in 3D. Futuristic lighting, holographic ads, and vibrant environments bring each level to life, drawing players into a world filled with neon-lit cityscapes and high-tech platforms. Check the visuals on the links below.

Challenges and Obstacles

Players must carefully monitor fuel levels, balancing passenger priorities with timely refueling stops. The growing complexity of levels introduces dynamic challenges like drones, angry robots, street cleaners and rising water levels that demand quick thinking and skilled navigation.

Game Progression

Each level introduces new gameplay elements that layer on existing mechanics to build increasing complexity. With objectives that vary from meeting passenger counts to maximizing daily earnings, players stay engaged as they unlock new challenges, hazards, and strategy options.

A Vibrant Cyberpunk World

SkyTaxi invites players into a futuristic world brimming with life and color. Immerse yourself in a bustling cyberpunk cityscape filled with neon lights, dynamic holograms, and vibrant skies. Every detail, from the glowing skyscrapers to the lively drone-filled skies, is designed to captivate and transport you to a visually stunning future.

Player Experience

SkyTaxi provides a fast-paced, casual gameplay experience where players tackle challenges and objectives while flying against the clock. With engaging mechanics and visually immersive environments, it offers a unique spin on the taxi-driving genre in a futuristic setting.

supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Simplified Chinese
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 SP1 or later (64-bit recommended)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti or AMD Radeon HD 7850 (2 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
  • VR Support: Not required
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 or AMD Radeon RX 580 (4 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card with surround support
  • VR Support: Not required

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.13 (High Sierra) or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (2015 or newer) or Apple M1 (via Rosetta 2)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel Iris Plus Graphics 645 or Apple M1 integrated GPU
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard macOS-compatible audio
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1 GPU or AMD Radeon Pro 560X (2 GB VRAM or higher)
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard macOS-compatible audio with surround support

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS or SteamOS 3.0 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any OpenAL-compatible audio device
  • VR Support: Not required
  • Additional Notes: Vulkan-compatible GPU drivers required.
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS, SteamOS 3.0, or a similar 64-bit Linux distribution
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060, AMD Radeon RX 580 (4 GB VRAM), or AMD RDNA 2 (Steam Deck)
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: OpenAL-compatible with 3D audio support
  • VR Support: Not required
  • Additional Notes: Vulkan API is recommended for better performance and compatibility. Game tested and verified on Proton (for Steam compatibility) or native Linux build.
